name: loreforge
description: LoreForge provides routing skills, capture tools, and conventions for operating LLM-wiki style expert-owned domain knowledge bases.

interface.longDescription: LoreForge helps agents route work across expert-owned LLM-wiki domains, query existing knowledge, capture web and document sources, update durable pages, review domain health, and keep agent-local experience in memory systems such as pamem.
defaultPrompt: Query my LoreForge wiki before searching.
Route this source to the right LoreForge domain.
Ingest this source into my LoreForge wiki.
Run a Health Check on this LoreForge domain.
